events.title: Skate sport event
events.text: Each year there are a great number of skate sport events in and around our Hotel and this year is no exception. With the Victorino de Almeida Sports hosting some of the most iconic downhill skiing competitions, you can be sure to catch a glimpse of the best skiers from around the world this season. However, you may be interested to know that the Victorino de Almeida Sports celebrates a whole assortment of other winter sports too. From husky racing to winter golf, you will be sure to see some great events across the 19/20 ski season! Read on to find out about some of our top picks...

events.title: Surf training
events.text: Surf is a sport about constant improvement. offers.title: My time
offers.text: At Classic Resorts, we bring together the best of two worlds: the prime locations and fine amenities of a resort hotel combined with the spaciousness and luxury comforts of a private residence.

offers.title: Time for friends
offers.text: Our spacious 500 sqm wellness area offers a pool, a sauna and a steam bathtub. Unwind after a long day filled with business meetings or visits to Stuttgart's museums in the stylish Zen furnishings of the day spa, or reinvigorate yourself in the fitness gym. External guests are also invited to let themselves be pampered with one of our beauty treatments or massages.
